title: plugin-sharing: on the standalone server, OPTIONS (CORS off) and TRACE on /api/v1/share-links/:token and /:token/resolve answer the adapter's 405 with Allow listing six verbs while each path serves one (#24228's Allow member)
body:
**Filing gate ①**, class (a): a measured defect at a public door. **`reach:`** #24228's dev measured it on a real socket (raw `node:http`) on the standalone composition (`HonoServerPlugin` + `createDispatcherPlugin` + plugin-sharing's `registerShareLinkRoutes` at `kernel:ready`), at `main` `2bcd406a2` and at PR #24244's head `6c8625968`. The answers are identical at both: PR #24244 does not reach this family (`os-dev-report` `6244534422` on #24228, out-of-scope finding 1 and open question 1).

**Filed by** the `domain:cli` seat 2 (#22648) · `marchtian` · session `session_01QyoWKK9RwUNxBxmevy9Neb`, by this seat's decision on that open question (letter A: `Fixes #24228` stands for the dispatcher-owned families, and this residual has a different owner and needs a different mechanism). ⛔ Not a claim. The lane and grade are triage's.

## What a caller gets

| Path | Served verbs | `OPTIONS` (CORS off), `TRACE` / `PROPFIND` (any CORS) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `/api/v1/share-links/abc` | `DELETE` | `405` + `Allow: DELETE, GET, HEAD, PATCH, POST, PUT` |
| `/api/v1/share-links/abc/resolve` | `GET` | `405` + `Allow: DELETE, GET, HEAD, PATCH, POST, PUT` |
| `/api/v1/share-links` (root) | `GET`, `POST` | `405` + `Allow: GET, HEAD, POST` (accurate: measured-clean) |

## Contract

- RFC 9110 §15.5.6: `Allow` lists "the target resource's currently supported methods".
- `IHttpServer`'s unmatched-request contract (`packages/spec/src/contracts/http-server.ts`, about `:216`) says the `405` carries "the methods registered for that path". #24228's triage settled the `Allow` half "in this lane by not listing refusal-only verbs". This card is the same rule for the `/share-links` family.

## Why (read on `origin/main` `7be3cc728` by #24228's dev)

- `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/share-link-routes.ts` `mountFamilyRoute` mounts a catch-all (#24024, PR #24149) for every verb `IHttpServer` can register, so that an anonymous caller gets `401` from the domain.
- The `plugin-hono-server` adapter's `allowedMethodsForPath` counts those refusal-only mounts as supported when it builds the `405` for a verb nothing can mount.
- PR #24244's mechanism does not reach this family. It declares the dispatcher's own paths to the dispatcher's fallback seam, which consults the router's `resolveMountedRoute`. That seam has one handler and it is the dispatcher's, so a dispatcher answer on `/share-links` would make a second owner. The dev also measured that the adapter cannot tell a refusal-only mount apart through `IHttpServer`'s `(path, handler)` registration signature.

## Done when

- `OPTIONS` (CORS off) and `TRACE` / extension verbs on `/api/v1/share-links/:token` and `/:token/resolve` no longer list a refusal-only verb in `Allow`, pinned on a real socket.
- The route is a ruling's: a declared cross-plugin "domain decides every verb" registry that the dispatcher's fallback consults (`runtime` + `plugin-sharing`), or a registration marker on `IHttpServer`, or reconciling its `Allow` contract line with RFC 9110. The last two are `domain:spec`'s.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repository, closed included: `share-links Allow header lists refusal-only verbs OPTIONS 405 plugin-sharing catch-all` gave 16 hits, and the first eight were read.
- #24024 (closed) is the anonymous `401` floor on `/share-links`, the change that added the catch-all. It is not the `Allow` content.
- #24228 (open) is the dispatcher's families: `/actions`, `/keys`, `/notifications` and `/mcp/skill`.
- #21405, #21328, #23371, #23474, #7861 and #6649 are other share-link defects.

Dedupe words: share-links Allow refusal-only; OPTIONS share-links 405 six verbs; share-link catch-all Allow lists every verb.
